verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents each piece separately: ESOP management and employee issuance, Board Resolutions & Voting, and in-house 409A valuations. Nothing in the evidence shows these joined into one workflow where a board-approved grant gets a strike price set from the 409A, and option grants specifically (versus shares) are only implied via ESOP management. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end option-grant workflow linking board approval to issuance, 409A-derived strike price applied to grants, explicit option-grant (not share) issuance docs, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue options to a new hire with a board approval flow and a 409A-compliant strike price in one end-to-end workflow
